response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.traitregistry, f.zoneref, f.articount, f.articount::numeric / t.artifact_total AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total <> 0), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM scored WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, traitregistry LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each nonmissing scanfeatures record is a separate count; a site can appear more than once. Shares are defined only when the overall artifact total is nonzero.

alternatives.interpretation: Combine all feature records for each site into one site artifact count, then compare site shares.
alternatives.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.articount::numeric / t.artifact_total AS share FROM site_counts AS s CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total <> 0), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM scored WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref LIMIT 10;
